notes.title: The Inter Update
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Level Cap and Arch Level:[/u] Players will now need to reach the level cap (50). After reaching the cap, players will be able to get Arch levels and keep earning profile points.
[*] [u]Skill Selection:[/u] Players will now be able to use 6 skills they chose. Players need to unlock skills and skill slots with their profile level.
[*] VSync has been added to the Options Menu.
[*] Anti-Aliasing has been added to the Options Menu.
[*] Runes for Heal, Dash and Shockwave have been added.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where using Meteor Shower right after Dash causing players to fall from the map. (Special thanks to Zorathul)
[*] Fixed an issue where pausing the game causes cooldowns to disappear, huge FPS drop and eventually crashes the game. (Special thanks to Zorathul)
[*] Fixed an issue where the explosion of Fire Blast blocks Fireballs. (You know it, Zorathul)
[*] Fixed an issue where players can use Rage skills after restarting the game. (Zorathul. We should have pay this guy)
[*] Fixed an issue where the explosion of Fire Blast spawns at random location.
[*] Fixed an issue where Heal can be casted while it is on cooldown.
[*] Fixed an issue where Molten Lava spawns at the top of Skeletons’ heads and we are not happy about it. It was really funny.
[*] Fixed an issue where the state of Streaming Checkbox doesn’t get saved.
[*] Fixed an issue where scores in the High Score table get duplicated.
[/list]

[b]Visual Effects[/b]
[list]
[*] Trail of Vortex now has a new VFX.
[*] Uncontrollable Flames now has a new VFX.
[*] Dash now has a new VFX.
[*] Fireball now has a new VFX.
[*] Explosion of Fire Blast now has a new VFX. 
[*] The Combustion rune of Fireball now has a new VFX.
[*] Molten Lava now has a new VFX.
[*] Fire Arrow now has a new VFX.
[*] Fire Wave now has a new VFX.
[*] Shockwave now has a new VFX.
[*] Enemy portal now has a new VFX.
[*] The aura effect of The Wizard now has a new VFX.
[*] Fireball of Skeleton Mages and The Wizard now has a new VFX.
[*] The sword aura of Death Knight now has a new VFX.
[*] The bow aura of The Huntress now has a new VFX.
[*] The arrow projectile of The Huntress now has a new VFX.
[*] Ragdoll has been added to some of the death animations.
[/list]

[b]UI/UX Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] All the menu pages now have new backgrounds.
[*] All the skill icons now have new designs.
[*] Checkboxes now have a new design.
[*] The Rage bar now has a new design.
[*] The action bar now has a new design.
[*] Health and Breath bars now have new designs. 
[*] The experience bar now has a new design.
[*] Confirmation box for Restart Game has been added.
[*] A rune image for Ring of Fire has been added.
[/list]

[b]Re-Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] New Breath usage formula has been added. Increasing Spell Damage from Profile Upgrade Page also increases Breath usage.
[*] Hit point formula for enemies is changed. Skeleton Footmen and The Brute is affected positively, rest is affected negatively from this change.
[*] Damage upgrade formula for enemies is nerfed.
[*] Movement speed upgrade formula for all skeletons has been capped.
[*] Explosion effect area of Demolisher Skeletons’ and The Boomer’s is lowered.
[*] Enemy spawners are combined and replaced around the map.
[*] Base cooldown of Fire Blast has been changed from 8 seconds to 4 seconds.
[*] Base cooldown of Fire Vortex has been changed from 14 seconds to 10 seconds.
[*] Base cooldown of Fire Bomb has been changed from 10 seconds to 8 seconds.
[*] Base cooldown of Uncontrollable Flames has been changed from 16 seconds to 10 seconds.
[*] Breath Usage of Uncontrollable Flames has been changed from 30 to 20.
[*] Base cooldown of Molten Lava has been changed from 24 seconds to 16 seconds.
[*] Base cooldown of Flaming Sword has been changed from 24 seconds to 14 seconds.
[*] Base cooldown of Meteor has been changed from 40 seconds to 20 seconds.
[*] Base cooldown of Shockwave has been changed from 60 seconds to 20 seconds.
[*] Breath usage of Shockwave has been changed from 40 to 20.
[*] Damage and life span of Comets has been increased.
[*] Time Manipulation rune of Fire Blast now also returns Breath.
[*] Passive Rage damage buff has been added.
[/list]

[b]Map Update[/b]
[list]
[*] The one and only Outskirts of Burcma Caste is polished.
[/list]

[b]Performance Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] LOD of foliages, props, every mesh on the map, characters, literally everything is optimized. 
[*] Visual effect of the Fire Ring rune is optimized.
[*] Fire effect on barrels which are carried by Demolisher Skeletons and The Boomer is optimized.
[*] New structure for saved files to improve loading times.
[*] Nearly every single line of code has been reworked both to improve performance and for the upcoming co-op patch.
[/list]


[i][u]Since we changed the structure of saved game files, you shouldn’t be able to load your old profiles. If you still can, we strongly recommend you to delete them to avoid any crashes.[/u][/i]

notes.title: New features and UI update is on the way!
notes.content:
Dear Ragers.

We are aware that we did not release a new patch for a while now. We want to inform you that we are still working on the game and we didn’t desert the development. 

We are currently working on an update, which will include level cap and skill selection features as well as a huge UI update.

See you in Burcma!

notes.title: Game Development Contest
notes.content:
Dear Ragers,

We have good news and bad news. 

Good news is, we joined a local game development contest a while ago and we reached the finals!  On the 5th of September, we will present Mage Rage to big shots of the game development industry of Turkey.

Bad news is, we won’t be able to work on the game and push any updates until 6th of September.

We will try to make you proud. Wish us luck!

notes.title: Yet Another Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Profiles will get 1 point to prevent profile name duplication. We are giving you a point just for writing your name!
[*] Not being able to move for 0,5 seconds after Meteor Shower is now fixed.
[*] Volume sliders now load correctly.
[*] EULA will not pop up randomly.
[*] Players will not be able to bind a key to more than one action anymore.
[/list]

[b]Re-Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Experience requirement for in-game level up formula has been changed from (IGL^2)*100 to IGL*200 except for level 2. You will still need 100 experience to be level 2.
[*] Players will not earn rage points anymore from enemies that are killed with rage skills.
[/list]

notes.title: More Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Heal won’t trigger “Skill is in cooldown” warning anymore when it is casted with full HP.
[*] Fireballs with Triple Strike rune won’t explode without any reason anymore.
[*] Typos. 
[/list]

[b]Re-Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemy damage has been reduced.
[*] Spawn timer of bosses has been increased.
[*] Character invulnerability while casting Meteor Shower is increased. Character will be invulnerable for 0.5 seconds after landing.
[*] Breath regeneration changed from 8% per second to 5% per second.
[/list]

[b]UI Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] HP value has been added to the in-game UI.
[*] Breath value has been added to the in-game UI.
[*] In-game level has been added to the in-game UI.
[/list]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now change movement keys via Key Bindings.
[*] You can now see how many available profile points you have on your profile page, above the “Profile Upgrades” button.
[*] Guides about skills have been added to the “Guide” menu.
[/list]

[u]We recommend you to create a new profile to completely experience this update.[/u]

notes.title: Balancing
notes.content:
Dear Ragers.

We are aware of balancing problems. We try to fix them everyday.

Your opinions are important to us. Please let us know if you have troubles about crazy strong enemies.

You can share your thoughts with us on Steam Discussions Panel. 

Best wishes!

Indie-dir Dev Team.

notes.title: Some Major Changes
notes.content:
[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Profile Level points decrease to minus values.
[*] Profile Level upgrades reset after using all points.
[*] Vortex runes change when the player changes Flaming Sword runes.
[*] Vortex is now smaller so as not to block the player's vision.
[*] Blocking volumes have been added to prevent players from falling down from the map at various locations.
[*] Typos.
[/list]

[b]Re-Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Score formula has been polished. Profile Level no longer is a multiplier. Players will get the same score from enemies no matter what their level is.
[*] The In-Game experience formula has been polished. Profile Level no longer is a multiplier. Players will get the same experience from enemies no matter what their level is.
[*] Character health is doubled.
[*] Heal skill is buffed.
[*] Cooldown reset after levelling up is removed.
[*] Required levels to unlock various skill runes have been changed.
[*] Boss spawn timers have been increased.
[*] The exploding area of the exploding skeleton boss is lowered.
[/list]

[b]New Feature:[/b]
[list]
[*] In-Game Current XP / In-Game XP Cap has been added to the UI.
[*] Selected skill runes now have frames to be more visible.
[*] Tooltip Texts have been added to the Profile Upgrade page.
[*] Guide page has been added. Currently gives info about in-game UI. More guides will be added soon.
[/list]


[u]We recommend you to create a new profile to completely experience this update.[/u]
